title: Sensors Module
summary: A student final project that uses the phone's built-in sensors to detect light, movement, tremor and falls, giving clinicians more insight into the patient.
description:
The sensors module was developed by students as their final project, as part of the generic platform behind [DMT – Proms++](/projects/dmt-proms).

It uses the phone's built-in sensors to detect factors such as **light levels, movement and shaking**. For example, it can notify the patient about a possible Parkinson's tremor or a fall. The data is uploaded to the clinic, giving the care team insights that help them support the patient better.
